slides.title: Tell *one person.*
slides.sub: Change you keep to yourself is easy to quietly drop.

slides.title: Why we keep it quiet
slides.body: If nobody knows, nobody sees us slip. That feels safer. It also lets the change fade without anyone noticing, even us.

slides.title: Pick the right person
slides.body: Not your loudest cheerleader or your harshest critic. Someone who will ask how it's going, and listen to the answer.

slides.title: Say it plainly
slides.body: "I'm working on not going quiet when I'm upset." One sentence. Not a promise. Just letting someone see it.

slides.title: Then notice.
slides.body: What did you feel saying it out loud? Relief? Embarrassment? The urge to take it back? That's worth paying attention to.
